panels.title: Attacker origins
panels.description: Each marker is one source IP, sized by hit count. Lat/lng come from GeoIP enrichment on CRITICAL alerts (and any other alert that was manually enriched via `enrich_ip`).

targets.queryText: SELECT source_ip AS ip, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') AS REAL) AS latitude, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.longitude') AS REAL) AS longitude, json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM alerts WHERE severity = 'critical' AND severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY hits DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT source_ip AS ip, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') AS REAL) AS latitude, CAST(json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.longitude') AS REAL) AS longitude, json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM alerts WHERE severity = 'critical' AND severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.latitude') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY hits DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE severity = 'critical' AND severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 25
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') AS country, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM alerts WHERE severity = 'critical' AND severity IN ('critical', 'high') AND timestamp BETWEEN datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch') AND json_extract(payload, '$.enrichment.geoip.country') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country ORDER BY hits DESC LIMIT 25

targets.queryText: WITH b AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE ($__from / 1000 + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END AS lo, CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN 0 ELSE $__to / 1000 / 3600 * 3600 END AS hi), w AS (SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0) AS honeypot_id, count AS n, bucket AS ts FROM alert_rollups, b WHERE lo < hi AND bucket >= datetime(lo, 'unixepoch') AND bucket < datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE timestamp >= datetime(f, 'unixepoch') AND ((lo < hi AND timestamp < datetime(lo, 'unixepoch')) OR (lo >= hi AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch'))) UNION ALL SELECT severity, event_type, source_ip, COALESCE(honeypot_id, 0), 1, timestamp FROM alerts, b WHERE lo < hi AND timestamp >= datetime(hi, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime(t, 'unixepoch')) SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', datetime(CAST(strftime('%s', ts) / (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END) AS INTEGER) * (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END), 'unixepoch')) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT source_ip) AS unique_ips FROM w GROUP BY CAST(strftime('%s', ts) / (CASE WHEN $__to - $__from < 21600000 THEN MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 60) ELSE (MAX(($__to - $__from) / 240000, 3600) + 3599) / 3600 * 3600 END) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY time
